71GW: : To take what rightfully belongs to another, is like a Muslim eating pork, or a Hindu eating beef.
Nanak, another's right is swine for him (the Musalman) and cow for him (the Hindu).
VCRQ: Our Guru, our Spiritual Guide, stands by us, if we do not eat those carcasses.
The spiritual guide and the prophet shall stand surety only then, if man eats not carrion.
1681: By mere talk, people do not earn passage to Heaven. Salvation comes only from the practice of Truth.
By mere talk man goes not to heaven. The deliverance is by the practice of truth alone.
APAQ: By adding spices to forbidden foods, they are not made acceptable.
By putting condiments in the unlawful food, it becomes not lawful.
5SEE: O Nanak, from false talk, only falsehood is obtained. ||2||
Nanak, from false talk only falsehood is obtained.
VV5C: There are five prayers and five times of day for prayer; the five have five names.
There are five prayers, five times for prayers, and the five have five names.
5U1G: Let the first be truthfulness, the second honest living, and the third charity in the Name of God.
The first is truthfulness, second the honest earning and third charity in God's Name.
NFP4: Let the fourth be good will to all, and the fifth the praise of the Lord.
The fourth is pure intent and mind and the fifth the Lord's admiration and praise.
7PQ3: Repeat the prayer of good deeds, and then, you may call yourself a Muslim.
Repeat you the creed of good deeds and then call yourself a Moslem.
7RNF: O Nanak, the false obtain falsehood, and only falsehood. ||3||
Nanak all the liars shall obtain what is altogether false.
1RY5: Some trade in priceless jewels, while others deal in mere glass.
Some trade in the invaluable commodity and others are the dealers in glass.
5YDF: When the True Guru is pleased, we find the treasure of the jewel, deep within the self.
If the True Guru be mightily pleased man finds the treasure of jewels within him.
2X9J: Without the Guru, no one has found this treasure. The blind and the false have died in their endless wanderings.
Without the Guru, none has found the Treasure. The false and the blind have perished in ceaseless wanderings.
2Z6U: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in duality. They do not understand contemplative meditation.
The wayward putrefy and dies in duality and understand not Divine comprehension.
26D0: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all. To whom should they complain?
Without one Lord there is no other. Before whom should your lodge a complaint?
32EU: Some are destitute, and wander around endlessly, while others have storehouses of wealth.
Some are without wealth and ceaselessly roam about and some have treasures full of wealth.
98XC: Without God's Name, there is no other wealth. Everything else is just poison and ashes.
Without God's Name, there is no other wealth. All else is but poison and ashes.
FSC6: O Nanak, the Lord Himself acts, and causes others to act; by the Hukam of His Command, we are embellished and exalted. ||7||
Nanak, the Lord himself does and Himself makes others do. By His order He reforms the mortals.
W1RJ: It is difficult to be called a Muslim; if one is truly a Muslim, then he may be called one.
To be called a Muslim is difficult. If one be really so then he may get himself called a Muslim.
9DS1: First, let him savor the religion of the Prophet as sweet; then, let his pride of his possessions be scraped away.
First he ought to deem sweet the religion of the Lord's devotees and have his pride of pelf effaced as rasped with a scraper.
VH5E: Becoming a true Muslim, a disciple of the faith of Mohammed, let him put aside the delusion of death and life.
Becoming the true disciple of the faith of the Prophet, let him put aside the illusion of death and life.
EG3R: As he submits to God's Will, and surrenders to the Creator, he is rid of selfishness and conceit.
He should heartily submit to the Lord's will, worship the Creator and efface his self-conceit.
FSCZ: And when, O Nanak, he is merciful to all beings, only then shall he be called a Muslim. ||1||
Therefore if he is merciful to all the sentient beings, O Nanak! then, alone he shall be called a Musalman.
AHNK: Renounce sexual desire, anger, falsehood and slander; forsake Maya and eliminate egotistical pride.
Renounce sexual pleasures, wrath, falsehood and calumny, forsake worldly valuables and dispel pride.
QV8Y: Renounce sexual desire and promiscuity, and give up emotional attachment. Only then shall you obtain the Immaculate Lord among the darkness of the world.
Put aside the lust for belles and leave worldly love. Then shall you obtain the bright Lord among the dark world.
3HC2: Renounce selfishness, conceit and arrogant pride, and your love for your children and spouse. Abandon your thirsty hopes and desires, and embrace love for the Lord.
Eschew self-adoration, egotism and affection for your sons and wife. Shed thirst and desire of wealth and embrace love for the omnipresent Lord.
NY3R: O Nanak, the True One shall come to dwell in your mind. Through the True Word of the Shabad, you shall be absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||2||
Nanak, he, in whose mind the True One abides, through the True Gurbani gets absorbed in God's Name.
S2DJ: Neither the kings, nor their subjects, nor the leaders shall remain.
Of the kings, subjects and chiefs none shall remain.
7YW4: The shops, the cities and the streets shall eventually disintegrate, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command.
The shops cities and streets shall disintegrate by the order of God.
SRC1: Those solid and beautiful mansions-the fools think that they belong to them.
The solidly built and beautiful mansions the fool deems his own.
9J7N: The treasure-houses, filled with wealth, shall be emptied out in an instant.
The treasures filled with wealth become empty in an instant.
UKKP: The horses, chariots, camels and elephants, with all their decorations;
Stallions, chariots, camels, elephants with decorations,
5P5B: the gardens, lands, houses, tents, soft beds and satin pavilions -
the gardens, properties, houses and buildings, O where are they which man considers his own,
2AEP: Oh, where are those things, which they believe to be their own?
including tents, cotton-tape webbed couches and satin pavillions?
QSYM: O Nanak, the True One is the Giver of all; He is revealed through His All-powerful Creative Nature. ||8||
Nanak, true is the Lord, the Bestower, who is recognised by His Omnipotence.

and were the mountains to become gold and silver and be studded with jewels and gems.

Even then, I would admire You, O Lord! and my yearning to utter Yours praises shall not abate.

Were I to arrest both the moon and the sun in their courses and were my seat to become ever stable.
M731: -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||2||
Even then I would admire You, O Lord! and my yearning to utter Yours praises shall not abate.

2URY: -even if this were my condition, I would still worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||3||
Even then I would admire You, O Lord! and my yearning to utter Yours praises shall not abate.
G1DQ: If fire and ice were my clothes, and the wind was my food;

and If the fascinating fairies of heaven be my wives, O Nanak! all this shall pass away.
ZB7A: Even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||4||
Even then I would magnify You, O Master! and my buoyant desire to repeat Yours eulogies ceases not.

The evil-doer is a demon, who knows not the Master.

He is said to be a mad-cap, who understands not his ownself.

Pernicious is strife in this world, In contention man is distracted.
97F2: Without the Lord's Name, life is worthless. Through doubt, the people are being destroyed.
Without God's Name, worthless is the mortal. In scepticism he is destroyed.

He, who deems both the ways lead to one Lord, shall be emancipated.
ULU5: One who speaks lies shall fall into hell and burn.
Fallen in the blasphemer's hell, the utterer of lies shall burn to ashes.
H9RF: In all the world, the most blessed and sanctified are those who remain absorbed in Truth.
In the whole world the most sanctified are they who remain absorbed in truth.
43UE: One who eliminates selfishness and conceit is redeemed in the Court of the Lord. ||9||
By eradicating his self-conceit, man is exonerated in Lord's Court.
HA2L: They alone are truly alive, whose minds are filled with the Lord.
He alone lives within whose mind that Master abides.
J65V: O Nanak, no one else is truly alive;
O Nanak! none else is really alive.
4PN1: those who merely live shall depart in dishonor;
O Nanak! none else is really alive.

AUER: Intoxicated with power and thrilled with wealth,
Intoxicated with power of authority and revelments of riches,
356N: They delight in their pleasures, and dance about shamelessly.
imbued with such pleasures the mortal dances shamelessly.
A4QL: O Nanak, they are deluded and defrauded.
Nanak, he is beguiled and defrauded.

Without the Lord's Name, he loses his honour and departs.

What can be achieved by eating and what by dressing so long as that True Lord abides not in the man's mind?
4EJV: What good are fruits, what good is ghee, sweet jaggery, what good is flour, and what good is meat?
What is fruit, what clarified butter and sweet molasses, what fine flour and what meat?
1BSK: What good are clothes, and what good is a soft bed, to enjoy pleasures and sensual delights?
What is raiment and what comfortable couch, to enjoy sexual intercourse and revelements?
5X4Y: What good is an army, and what good are soldiers, servants and mansions to live in?
Of what use is an army and of what the mace-bearers, servants and coming and dwelling in mansions?
R91P: O Nanak, without the True Name, all this paraphernalia shall disappear. ||2||
Nanak, without the True Name, the entire paraphernalia is perishable.

What is in the power of caste? Righteousness is to be assayed.
W9SR: Pride in one's status is like poison-holding it in your hand and eating it, you shall die.
High caste pride is like poison by holding in hand and eating which the man dies.
GHZC: The True Lord's Sovereign Rule is known throughout the ages.
The sovereignty of the True Lord is known throughout all the ages.
Z8AQ: One who respects the Hukam of the Lord's Command is honored and respected in the Court of the Lord.
He who obeys the Lord's order becomes a noble in His Court.
VAC0: By the Order of our Lord and Master, we have been brought into this world.
Enjoining the performance of His service the Lord has sent the mortal in this world.
0KMH: The Drummer, the Guru, has announced the Lord's meditation, through the Word of the Shabad.
The Guru-drummer has by means of Gurbani, proclaimed this meditation of the Lord.
N8FZ: Some have mounted their horses in response, and others are saddling up.
Hearing this some have mounted their horses and some are caparisoning to them.
TVJ5: Some have tied up their bridles, and others have already ridden off. ||10||
Some have tied their bundles and some have even ridden off.
9XLE: When the crop is ripe, then it is cut down; only the stalks are left standing.
When the crop is ripe, it is cut then. Only the straw and hedge remain.
14QG: The corn on the cob is put into the thresher, and the kernels are separated from the cobs.
Along with the bristled ears the crop is thrashed and by winnowing the corn is separated from the crop.
ZCC3: Placing the kernels between the two mill-stones, people sit and grind the corn.
Joining together both the quern-stones people come and sit down to grind the corn.
0MUE: Those kernels which stick to the central axle are spared-Nanak has seen this wonderful vision! ||1||
They, which remain attached to the central axle, are saved Nanak has seen a wonderful thing.
GUK7: Look, and see how the sugar-cane is cut down. After cutting away its branches, its feet are bound together into bundles,
See, that the sugarcane is sheared. After cleansing and chopping off its plumes its feet are bound to form it into bundles.

YLMQ: and then, it is placed between the wooden rollers and crushed.
Placing it in between the wooden rollers of the press, they crush and award it punishment.
9DFR: What punishment is inflicted upon it! Its juice is extracted and placed in the cauldron; as it is heated, it groans and cries out.
Extracting the juice, they put it in the cauldron and it groans as it burns.
XG2S: And then, the crushed cane is collected and burnt in the fire below.
Even the empty crushed cane is collected and is burnt in the fire.
A67J: Nanak: come, people, and see how the sweet sugar-cane is treated! ||2||
Nanak, how the sweet-leaved sugarcane is treated, come and see, O people!
7E92: Some do not think of death; they entertain great hopes.
Some think not of death and entertain many hopes.
G2NQ: They die, and are re-born, and die, over and over again. They are of no use at all!
They ever die, perish and are reborn and are of no avail.
J62Z: In their conscious minds, they call themselves good.
In their heart of heart they call themselves good.
K7P1: The King of the Angels of Death hunts down those self-willed manmukhs, over and over again.
The king of the angels of death for ever and aye stalks the apostate.
MBHE: The manmukhs are false to their own selves; they feel no gratitude for what they have been given.
The perverse person is untrue to his salt and feels not indebted for the good done to him.
ED9E: Those who merely perform rituals of worship are not pleasing to their Lord and Master.
They, who pay homage under compulsion are not pleasing to the Lord.
WJ1W: Those who attain the True Lord and chant His Name are pleasing to the Lord.
They who obtain the exalted True Name are liked by the master.
XYQT: They worship the Lord and bow at His Throne. They fulfill their pre-ordained destiny. ||11||
They who obtain good destiny bow before the Lord's throne.
J1BV: What can deep water do to a fish? What can the vast sky do to a bird?
What can the deep water do to a fish and what the sky to the bird?
30C7: What can cold do to a stone? What is married life to a eunuch?
What can cold do to a stone and what the married life to an eunuch?
K8TV: You may apply sandalwood oil to a dog, but he will still be a dog.
Sandal may be applied to a dog even then he will preserve his canine nature.
BYLD: You may try to teach a deaf person by reading the Simritees to him, but how will he learn?
Though one may instruct a deaf man and read for him Simirtis and other religious recitations,
4BRY: You may place a light before a blind man and burn fifty lamps, but how will he see?
Though one may place a light before a blind man and burn fifty lamps for him but all is in vain.
6UC6: You may place gold before a herd of cattle, but they will pick out the grass to eat.
Though one may put gold before a herd of cattle but they will pick out and select grass to eat.
445R: You may add flux to iron and melt it, but it will not become soft like cotton.
If flux be put into iron, it will melt but will not become cotton.
HRRS: O Nanak, this is the nature of a fool-everything he speaks is useless and wasted. ||1||
Nanak the nature of a fool is this that he always talks of the mortal sins.
UKPG: When pieces of bronze or gold or iron break,
When bronze, gold and iron break,
CPG2: the metal-smith welds them together again in the fire, and the bond is established.
the smith effects welding with fire.
YEDX: If a husband leaves his wife,
When the husband separates away from wife,
3K79: their children may bring them back together in the world, and the bond is established.
through the son reconciliation is effected in this world.
5X6T: When the king makes a demand, and it is met, the bond is established.
When the king makes a demand by meeting it the bond is established.
4KX4: When the hungry man eats, he is satisfied, and the bond is established.
The hungry man attains appeasement, when he eats something.
PKCM: In the famine, the rain fills the streams to overflowing, and the bond is established.
Relief from famine is attained if it rains and the stream be overflowing.
94XQ: There is a bond between love and words of sweetness.
There is an affinity between love and sweet words.
0YMK: When one speaks the Truth, a bond is established with the Holy Scriptures.
If any one speak the Truth, he establishes a link with the holy scriptures.
KMF7: Through goodness and truth, the dead establish a bond with the living.
By goodness and truth the dead establish a bond with the living.
J499: Such are the bonds which prevail in the world.
Such are the alliances which prevail in this world.
2CZC: The fool establishes his bonds only when he is slapped in the face.
The fool is mended only on being struck in the face.
BV3T: Nanak says this after deep reflection:
Nanak says this after due deliberation.
KUP7: through the Lord's Praise, we establish a bond with His Court. ||2||
Through the Lord's praise the tie with His court is established.
7HGD: He Himself created and adorned the Universe, and He Himself contemplates it.
Himself creating the universe God Himself gives it thought.
6D3F: Some are counterfeit, and some are genuine. He Himself is the Appraiser.
Some are false and some true. The Lord Himself is the Assayer.
RX3U: The genuine are placed in His Treasury, while the counterfeit are thrown away.
The genuine are consigned to His Treasury, while the counterfeit are thrown outside.
SDK6: The counterfeit are thrown out of the True Court-to whom should they complain?
The false are cast aside from the True Court. Before whom can they prefer a complaint?
6RJ9: They should worship and follow the True Guru-this is the lifestyle of excellence.
They should run to the True Guru's sanctuary. This is the rightful way of life.
YH7V: The True Guru converts the counterfeit into genuine; through the Word of the Shabad, He embellishes and exalts us.
The True Guru turns the impure into pure. He is the embellisher of man with God's Name.
MGHA: Those who have enshrined love and affection for the Guru, are honored in the True Court.
By enshrining affection and love for the Guru the mortals are honoured in the True Court.
9XQ1: Who can estimate the value of those who have been forgiven by the Creator Lord Himself? ||12||
Who can reckon the worth of those who have been pardoned by the Creator Himself?
HGH7: All the spiritual teachers, their disciples and the rulers of the world shall be buried under the ground.
All the spiritual guides their disciples and monarchs of the world are beneath the earth.
UQQM: The emperors shall also pass away; God alone is Eternal.
The kings shall pass away. God alone is ever flourishing.
EQJW: You alone are, You alone are, O Lord!
RKWL: Neither the angels, nor the demons, nor human beings,
Neither gods, nor demons or men,
64L2: Nor the Siddhas, nor the seekers shall remain on the earth.
nor men of miracles or seekers shall stay on earth.
HRQV: The Lord alone is. Who else can there be?

PW95: You alone are, O Lord! You alone are.
9JGD: Neither the just, nor the generous, nor any humans at all,
Neither the just, nor the generous nor other men,
HTMN: Nor the seven realms beneath the earth, shall remain.
nor the seven worlds beneath the earth, shall remain.
HWQK: The One Lord alone exists. Who else is there?
The Lord alone is. Who else can there be?
CY83: You alone are, O Lord! You alone are.
KZ3E: Neither the sun, nor the moon, nor the planets,
Neither the solar and lunar regions,
T6YU: Nor the seven continents, nor the oceans,
nor seven continents, nor the ocean,
KNCH: Nor food, nor the wind-nothing is permanent.
nor the corn or the wind; nothing is stable.
MCH7: You alone are, O Lord! You alone are.
KSTR: Our sustenance is not in the hands of any person.
The sustenance is not in the hands of any one.
THPE: The hopes of all rest in the One Lord.
Hopes of all abide in the one Lord.
6F3J: The One Lord alone exists-who else is there?
The Lord alone is who else can there be?
Y013: You alone are, O Lord! You alone are.
WKYB: The birds have no money in their pockets.
The birds have no money in their pockets.
THY3: They place their hopes on trees and water.
They rest their hope on water and trees.
Z8MN: You alone are, O Lord! You alone are.
1A0D: O Nanak, that destiny which is pre-ordained and written on one's forehead
Nanak, what is written on the forehead,
4PFS: The Lord infuses strength, and He takes it away again.
That Lord instills power in the mortal and then resumes it.
BADB: You alone, O Lord, You alone. ||7||
You alone are, O Lord! You alone are.
JQPD: True is the Hukam of Your Command. To the Gurmukh, it is known.
True is Yours command, O Lord! Through the Guru, it is known.
B5FA: Through the Guru's Teachings, selfishness and conceit are eradicated, and the Truth is realized.
Eradicating self by the Guru's instruction, I have recognised the Truth.
4UCD: True is Your Court. It is proclaimed and revealed through the Word of the Shabad.
True is Yours Court which becomes manifest through the Guru's gospel.
6JPS: Meditating deeply on the True Word of the Shabad, I have merged into the Truth.
By meditating on the True Name I have been absorbed in the True One.
91UL: The self-willed manmukhs are always false; they are deluded by doubt.
Your self-willed are ever false. They are deluded by doubt.
XXZR: They dwell in manure, and they do not know the taste of the Name.
In ordure is their abode. They know not the Name's relish.
8QU7: Without the Name, they suffer the agonies of coming and going.
Without God's Name, they suffer agony in coming and going.
590Q: O Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Appraiser, who distinguishes the counterfeit from the genuine. ||13||
Nanak the Lord Himself is the Assayer, who distinguishes the counterfeit and the genuine.
4MB0: Tigers, hawks, falcons and eagles-the Lord could make them eat grass.
The tigers, hawks, kites and falcons them the Lord causes to eat grass.
P4KG: And those animals which eat grass-He could make them eat meat. He could make them follow this way of life.
Who eat grass, them He causes to eat meat. This way of life He can set going.
JKNQ: He could raise dry land from the rivers, and turn the deserts into bottomless oceans.
He exhibits mounds in rivers and the deserts He makes into unfathomable oceans.
11U1: He could appoint a worm as king, and reduce an army to ashes.
A worm, He appoints to kingship and He reduces an army to ashes.
DJN3: All beings and creatures live by breathing, but He could keep us alive, even without the breath.
All the sentient beings live by breathing. What can breath do then, if He wishes to sustain life?
ZLS4: O Nanak, as it pleases the True Lord, He gives us sustenance. ||1||
Nanak, as it pleases the True Lord, so does He give sustenance.
FQ5V: Some eat meat, while others eat grass.
Some are meat eaters and some eat grass.
4HQJ: Some have all the thirty-six varieties of delicacies,
Some obtain delicacies of thirty six sorts.
NW61: while others live in the dirt and eat mud.
Some abide in the earth and eat the mud.
3UJ1: Some control the breath, and regulate their breathing.
Some are breath-controller and count their breaths.
R4RH: Some live by the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.
Some are the adorers of the Formless Lord and have the Name's support.
7TNK: The Great Giver lives; no one dies.
The Donor ever lives. None dies of privation.
HZPQ: O Nanak, those who do not enshrine the Lord within their minds are deluded. ||2||
Nanak they who keep not that Lord in their mind are beguiled.
HEQM: By the karma of good actions, some come to serve the Perfect Guru.
By good fortune does man perform the service of the perfect Guru.
DJSR: Through the Guru's Teachings, some eliminate selfishness and conceit, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Effacing his self under the Guru's instruction the mortal meditates on God's Name.
EDTD: Undertaking any other task, they waste their lives in vain.
By taking to another task man wastes his life.
05LR: Without the Name, all that they wear and eat is poison.
Without the Name all which man wears and eats is poison.
PN4Z: Praising the True Word of the Shabad, they merge with the True Lord.
By praising the True Name one merges in the True Master.
V3WY: Without serving the True Guru, they do not obtain the home of peace; they are consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.
Without serving the True Guru, one attains not an abode in peace and is born over and over again.
WUJW: Investing counterfeit capital, they earn only falsehood in the world.
With the false capital the mortal earns falsehood in the world.
06NX: O Nanak, singing the Praises of the Pure, True Lord, they depart with honor. ||14||
Nanak by singing the praises of the Pure True Lord man departs with honour.
QU3A: When it pleases You, we play music and sing; when it pleases You, we bathe in water.
When it pleases You then man plays upon musical instruments and sings. When it is Yours will he bathes in water.

8YJG: When it pleases You, we smear our bodies with ashes, and blow the horn and the conch shell.
When it pleases You, O Lord! then the mortal smears his body with ashes and sounds the horn and the shell.
CM9D: When it pleases You, we read the Islamic Scriptures, and are acclaimed as Mullahs and Shaykhs.
When it pleases You one reads then the Muslim texts, and is acclaimed a Mullah and a Sheikh.
HBUC: When it pleases You, we become kings, and enjoy all sorts of tastes and pleasures.
When it is Your will Then they become kings and enjoy good many sweet and saltish savours.
38CU: When it pleases You, we wield the sword, and cut off the heads of our enemies.
When it is Your will men wield the sword and sever the head from the neck.
Y820: When it pleases You, we go out to foreign lands; hearing news of home, we come back again.
When it is Yours will, O master! people go in foreign lands and hearing various news, return home.
UWRQ: When it pleases You, we are attuned to the Name, and when it pleases You, we become pleasing to You.
When it is Yours pleasure man is absorbed in Your Name and when it is Your will he becomes pleasing to You.
V5PP: Nanak utters this one prayer; everything else is just the practice of falsehood. ||1||
Nanak makes one supplication (that he may walk according to Your will). All else is to practice false-hood.
ZJAB: You are so Great-all Greatness flows from You. You are So Good-Goodness radiates from You.
As You are great all the greatness emanates from You. Being good You doest nothing but Good.
VRLJ: You are True-all that flows from You is True. Nothing at all is false.
When You are True then all that flows from You is true. Absolutely nothing is false.
4X1N: Talking, seeing, speaking, walking, living and dying-all these are transitory.
Talking, seeing, uttering, living, walking and perishing are from You, O Lord.
V3ZJ: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates, and in His Command, He keeps us. O Nanak, He Himself is True. ||2||
Nanak, the True Lord Himself creates by His order and in His order He keeps all the beings.
Y2UG: Serve the True Guru fearlessly, and your doubt shall be dispelled.
Fearlessly serve the True Guru and your wandering shall cease.
CYN6: Do that work which the True Guru asks you to do.
Do you that work, the work which the True Guru asks you to do.
HQHZ: When the True Guru becomes merciful, we meditate on the Naam.
If the True Guru becomes merciful, then alone can we dwell on the Name.
8UWX: The profit of devotional worship is excellent. It is obtained by the Gurmukh.
The illustrious and genuine profit of the devotional service of God is obtained through the Guru.
WVS9: The self-willed manmukhs are trapped in the darkness of falsehood; they practice nothing but falsehood.
The way-ward person is in the inky darkness of falsehood and practises falsehood.
B3KK: Go to the Gate of Truth, and speak the Truth.
Arrive at the True Guru's gate and repeat the True Name, O man.
LEUE: The True Lord calls the true ones to the Mansion of His Presence.
The true ones are called within the mansion of the True Master.
WU5J: O Nanak, the true ones are forever true; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||15||
Nanak the truthful person is, for ever true and is absorbed in the True Being.
LPT2: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the knife, and the kings are butchers; righteousness has sprouted wings and flown away.
The dark-age is the scalpel, the kings are the butchers and righteousness has taken wings and flown.
QKPG: In this dark night of falsehood, the moon of Truth is not visible anywhere.
In this no-moon night of false-hood, the moon of truth is not seen to rise anywhere.
B7R2: I have searched in vain, and I am so confused;
In my search, I have become bewildered.
Q93E: In this darkness, I cannot find the path.
In darkness, I find no path.
CZDH: In egotism, they cry out in pain.
By taking pride, mortal bewails in pain.
BEY7: Says Nanak, how will they be saved? ||1||
Says Nanak by what means can the mortal be delivered?
KXER: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has appeared as a Light in the world.
In This dark age the Lord's praise has appeared as a light for the world.
F4JP: How rare are those few Gurmukhs who swim across to the other side!
Through the Guru, a few swim across the life-ocean.
6V3V: The Lord bestows His Glance of Grace;
The Lord bestows this light to him on whom He casts His merciful glance.
L68U: O Nanak, the Gurmukh receives the jewel. ||2||
Nanak, through the Guru he (such a man) receives the Name jewel.
0XWG: Between the Lord's devotees and the people of the world, there can never be any true alliance.
Between the devotees of God and worldly men there can never be an alliance.
W64M: The Creator Himself is infallible. He cannot be fooled; no one can fool Him.
The Creator Himself is infallible Duped by any one he errs not.
3R28: He blends His devotees with Himself; they practice Truth, and only Truth.
His saints, who practise the whole truth, the Maker blends with His own self.
3GL7: The Lord Himself leads the people of the world astray; they tell lies, and by telling lies, they eat poison.
The world-hardened men, who eat poison by repeatedly telling lies the Lord Himself has led astray.
77KF: They do not recognize the ultimate reality, that we all must go; they continue to cultivate the poisons of sexual desire and anger.
They know not the ultimate reality of departure and increase the poison of lust and wrath.
QZSZ: The devotees serve the Lord; night and day, they meditate on the Naam.
The devotees, who night and day meditate on the Name perform God's service.
LN5Y: Becoming the slaves of the Lord's slaves, they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.
Becoming the slave of the Lord's slaves they efface their self conceit from within them.
E4FF: In the Court of their Lord and Master, their faces are radiant; they are embellished and exalted with the True Word of the Shabad. ||16||
Bright are their countenances in the Husband's Court, and they are adorned with the True Name.
L125: Those who praise the Lord in the early hours of the morning and meditate on Him single-mindedly,
Who praise God in the early morn and meditate on Him with single mind;
ZWTM: are the perfect kings; at the right time, they die fighting.
They are the perfect kings and they die fighting against the deadly sins at the right time.
VBMA: In the second watch, the focus of the mind is scattered in all sorts of ways.
In the second watch there are many ways in which the attention of the mind is scattered.
X5DQ: So many fall into the bottomless pit; they are dragged under, and they cannot get out again.
Many fall into the unfathomable water, suffer immersions and cannot emerge out.

5CKB: In the third watch, both hunger and thirst bark for attention, and food is put into the mouth.
In the third watch, when both hunger and thirst bark, the morsels of food are put in the mouth.
2MA3: That which is eaten becomes dust, but they are still attached to eating.
What is eaten become ashes, but still man has got friendship with eating.
BT61: In the fourth watch, they become drowsy. They close their eyes and begin to dream.
In the fourth watch drowsiness comes he closes his eyes and goes into the dream-land.
N0MJ: Rising up again, they engage in conflicts; they set the stage as if they will live for 100 years.
Rising up he again engages in strife and sets the stage as if he is to live for hundreds of years.
RKAL: If at all times, at each and every moment, they live in the fear of God
If, at all times and every moment, during the eight watches of the day man feels fear of God.
XPM7: -O Nanak, the Lord dwells within their minds, and their cleansing bath is true. ||1||
O Nanak! the Lord abides within his mind and true becomes his ablution.
8HEK: They are the perfect kings, who have found the Perfect Lord.
They are the perfect bankers, who have found the perfect Lord.
UY5X: Twenty-four hours a day, they remain unconcerned, imbued with the Love of the One Lord.
Throughout the eight watches of the day they remain unconcerned, and in the love of one God.
LCD4: Only a few obtain the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Unimaginably Beauteous Lord.
Hardly any one can obtain the sight of the infinitely beauteous Lord.
GQFN: Through the perfect karma of good deeds, one meets the Perfect Guru, whose speech is perfect.
Through perfect good fortune man meets the Perfect Guru whose speech is perfect.
69FK: O Nanak, when the Guru makes one perfect, one's weight does not decrease. ||2||
Nanak if the Guru makes man perfect his weight decreases not.
JXZB: When You are with me, what more could I want? I speak only the Truth.
When You are mine what more do I desire? I tell the truth O my Lord!
JSFJ: Plundered by the thieves of worldly affairs, she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence.
She, who is defrauded by the thievish worldly affairs, obtains not her Lord's palace.
JN9S: Being so stone-hearted, she has lost her chance to serve the Lord.
Her mind is so much stone-hearted that she loses the chance of his service.
6VPN: That heart, in which the True Lord is not found, should be torn down and re-built.
The heart, where-in the True Lord is not found that should be destroyed and re-built.
VKEZ: How can she be weighed accurately, upon the scale of perfection?
When weighed with the perfect weights how can her weight be found to be correct?
CK4S: No one will say that her weight has been shorted, if she rids herself of egotism.
If her ego goes, no one will say she is of short weight.
U1CV: The genuine are assayed, and accepted in the Court of the All-knowing Lord.
The genuine are assayed and accepted in the Court of the All-seeing Lord.
EYFY: The genuine merchandise is found only in one shop-it is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||17||
The true merchandise is in only one shop. It is obtained from the perfect Guru.
1HER: Twenty-four hours a day, destroy the eight things, and in the ninth place, conquer the body.
During the eight watches of the day and night, O mortal! destroy eight things (five deadly sins and three qualities) and in the ninth place, do subdue your body.
13T7: Within the body are the nine treasures of the Name of the Lord-seek the depths of these virtues.
Within the body are the nine treasures of the unique Lord's Name. The virtuous and profound persons search those treasures.
FCUJ: Those blessed with the karma of good actions praise the Lord. O Nanak, they make the Guru their spiritual teacher.
Making the Guru their spiritual guide the fortunate sing the praises of the Lord, O Nanak!
LPMF: In the fourth watch of the early morning hours, a longing arises in their higher consciousness.
In the fourth watch of the early morn, yearning arises in the mind of the men of exalted understanding.
0KSZ: They are attuned to the river of life; the True Name is in their minds and on their lips.
They have friendship with the streams and in their mind and mouth is the True Name.
0SWQ: The Ambrosial Nectar is distributed, and those with good karma receive this gift.
There ambrosia is distributed and the fortunate receive Name's gift.
1J79: Their bodies become golden, and take on the color of spirituality.
The body is assayed like gold and takes on the colour of spiritual progress.
XX6J: If the Jeweller casts His Glance of Grace, they are not placed in the fire again.
If the jeweler casts His merciful glance it is not again put in the fire.
GFQX: Throughout the other seven watches of the day, it is good to speak the Truth, and sit with the spiritually wise.
During the other seven watches, it is good to speak the truth and sit with the literates.
NBAQ: There, vice and virtue are distinguished, and the capital of falsehood is decreased.
There vice and virtue are discriminated and the capital of falsehood decreases.
X2YH: There, the counterfeit are cast aside, and the genuine are cheered.
There the counterfeit are cast aside and the genuine are applauded.
VMWC: Speech is vain and useless. O Nanak, pain and pleasure are in the power of our Lord and Master. ||1||
Vain is man's utterance, O Nanak! the weal and woe are near (in the power of) the Master.
B7LB: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.
Air is the Guru, water is the Father, earth the great Mother,
WDZ4: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.
and day and night the two male nurse and female nurse, in whose lap the entire world plays.
HX9S: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.
The merits and demerits shall he read in the presence of the Righteous Justice.
QD00: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.
According to their respective deeds some shall be near some distant from the Lord.
Q4W4: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brow
They who have pondered on the Name and have departed after putting in toil.
5K12: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many others are saved along with them! ||2||
Nanak, their faces shall be bright and many shall be emancipated along with them.
ZNLW: The True Food is the Love of the Lord; the True Guru has spoken.
The True food is the Lord's love. So says the True Guru.
PXKC: With this True Food, I am satisfied, and with the Truth, I am delighted.
With the True Good I am appeased and with Truth I am delighted.
73YM: True are the cities and the villages, where one abides in the True Home of the self.
True are the citadels and hamlets of him, who abides in his own home.
810V: When the True Guru is pleased, one receives the Lord's Name, and blossoms forth in His Love.
When the True Guru is pleased man receives the Name and flowers in the Lord's love.
WW27: No one enters the Court of the True Lord through falsehood.
In the Court of the True Lord, one cannot enter through false-hood.
9UK1: By uttering falsehood and only falsehood, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.
By telling nothing but untruth, that mansion of the Lord is lost.

94HJ: No one blocks the way of those who are blessed with the Banner of the True Word of the Shabad.
No one obstructs the way of him, who goes with the True Name's flag.
BBHC: Hearing, understanding and speaking Truth, one is called to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||18||
By hearing, realising and uttering the True Name one is called to the Lord's palace.
10FH: If I dressed myself in fire, and built my house of snow, and made iron my food;
If I put on the dress of fire, found a house in snow and make iron my food;
P6TW: and if I were to drink in all pain like water, and drive the entire earth before me;
All the troubles if I drink as water and drive before me the earth;
NPSS: and if I were to place the earth upon a scale and balance it with a single copper coin;
By placing the firmament in the balance pan, were I to weight it with a mere copper put in the hind pan;
VHCQ: and if I were to become so great that I could not be contained, and if I were to control and lead all;
Were I to become so large that I could nowhere be contained and were I to snaffle and lead by the nose one and all;
H1MN: and if I were to possess so much power within my mind that I could cause others to do my bidding-so what?
If I possess so much power within my mind that I perform and also at my bidding cause others perform such things but all this is in vain.
EQFZ: As Great as our Lord and Master is, so great are His gifts. He bestows them according to His Will.
As great as the Lord is so great are His gifts. He bestows them according to His pleasure.
AXT9: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain the glorious greatness of the True Name. ||1||
Nanak he on whom the Lord casts His merciful glance, obtains the glory of the True Name.
BYN0: The mouth is not satisfied by speaking, and the ears are not satisfied by hearing.
The mouth is not sated with speech and the ears are not sated with hearing.
6V8S: The eyes are not satisfied by seeing-each organ seeks out one sensory quality.
The eyes are not sated with what they see. Each organ is the purchaser of one sort of trait.
FK79: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased; by mere words, hunger is not relieved.
The hunger of the hungry departs not. By mere words of mouth the hunger goes not.
CTY2: O Nanak, hunger is relieved only when one utters the Glorious Praises of the Praiseworthy Lord. ||2||
O Nanak! only then, is the hungry man satiated when, by uttering His praises, he gets absorbed in the Praise-worthy Lord.
WF1K: Without the True One, all are false, and all practice falsehood.
Without the True Lord, all are false and practise falsehood.
R7NS: Without the True One, the false ones are bound and gagged and driven off.
Without the True One, the false are bound down and goaded on.
WN9R: Without the True One, the body is just ashes, and it mingles again with ashes.
Without the True Master, the body is dust and is mingled with dust.
DB4J: Without the True Ome, all food and clothes are unsatisfying.
Without the True Master, the dress and food are all hunger.
ECPF: Without the True One, the false ones do not attain the Lord's Court.
Without the True Lord, the false attain not God's Court.
DHFV: Attached to false attachments, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.
Being attached to false avarice man loses the Master's mansion.
RBNP: The whole world is deceived by deception, coming and going in reincarnation.
The whole world is deceived by the deceitful mammon and continues coming and going.
Y9G3: Within the body is the fire of desire; through the Word of the Shabad, it is quenched. ||19||
In the body is the fire of desire. With God's Name it is quenched.
1QYF: O Nanak, the Guru is the tree of contentment, with flowers of faith, and fruits of spiritual wisdom.
Nanak the Guru is the tree of contentment, whose flower is faith, and fruit the Divine knowledge.
UB1N: Watered with the Lord's Love, it remains forever green; through the karma of good deeds and meditation, it ripens.
Irrigated with the Lord's love, it remains evergreen and it ripens by virtuous deeds and meditation.
RB2H: Honor is obtained by eating this tasty dish; of all gifts, this is the greatest gift. ||1||
Honour is obtained by partaking of its relish. Of all the gifts this is the greatest gift.
JMUU: The Guru is the tree of gold, with leaves of coral, and blossoms of jewels and rubies.
The Guru is the tree of gold, its leaves are corals, and its blossoms jewels and rubies.
E7AN: The Words from His Mouth are fruits of jewels. Within His Heart, He beholds the Lord.
That plant bears the fruit of emerald of the utterance of the Guru's mouth. Within the heart of his heart the Guru beholds the Lord.
9FC6: O Nanak, He is obtained by those, upon whose faces and foreheads such pre-recorded destiny is written.
Nanak it is obtained by him on whose face and forehead the writ of good fortune is recorded.
M6MW: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are contained in the constant worship of the feet of the Exalted Guru.
The sixty-eight places of pilgrimage seek the shelter of the most exalted Guru's feet, whom they ever worship.
J107: Cruelty, material attachment, greed and anger are the four rivers of fire.
Cruelty, worldly love, avarice and wrath are the four streams of fire.
7B06: Falling into them, one is burned, O Nanak! One is saved only by holding tight to good deeds. ||2||
By falling into them the mortal is burnt, O Nanak! Emancipation is obtained by cleaving to good deed.
XNSQ: While you are alive, conquer death, and you shall have no regrets in the end.
While living subdue death and you shall not regret afterwards.
F4D2: This world is false, but only a few understand this.
False is the world but a few understand this.
6BKZ: People do not enshrine love for the Truth; they chase after worldly affairs instead.
Man professes not live for truth and runs after worldly affairs.
0JPG: The terrible time of death and annihilation hovers over the heads of the world.
The inauspicious time of annihilating death stands over the head of the world.
53RP: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the Messenger of Death smashes his club over their heads.
Under the Lord's command, seizing an opportunity, death's myrmidon strikes the club on man's head.
J1HB: The Lord Himself gives His Love, and enshrines it within their minds.
The Lord Himself bestows His love and enshrines it within the mortal's mind.
5NXG: Not a moment or an instant's delay is permitted, when one's measure of life is full.
When the life's measure is full not a trice or moment's delay is caused in departing.
75V2: By Guru's Grace, one comes to know the True One, and is absorbed into Him. ||20||
Through the Guru's grace by knowing the True Lord the mortal is absorbed in Him.
JXAN: Bitter melon, swallow-wort, thorn-apple and nim fruit
The bitterness of the gourd, colocynth, colotropis procera, thorn-apple and the seed of aza-dirachta,
BWPJ: these bitter poisons lodge in the minds and mouths of those who do not remember You
abides in the mind and mouth of him, who remembers you not, O my Lord!
ZHZF: O Nanak, how shall I tell them this? Without the karma of good deeds, they are only destroying themselves. ||1||
Nanak, whom should I tell that who-so are without good destiny are annihilated.
6EN1: The intellect is a bird; on account of its actions, it is sometimes high, and sometimes low.
The bird soul with (on account of) its actions is sometimes exalted and sometimes debased.

Q3PN: Sometimes it is perched on the sandalwood tree, and sometimes it is on the branch of the poisonous swallow-wort. Sometimes, it soars through the heavens.
Sometime it perches on the sandal tree and sometimes on the branch of colotropis procera. Sometimes it loves to soar high.
6RK5: O Nanak, our Lord and Master leads us on, according to the Hukam of His Command; such is His Way. ||2||
Nanak, The Lord sticks to the habit of driving the beings according to His will.
DXCU: Some speak and expound, and while speaking and lecturing, they pass away.
Some explain and expound on the Lord and depart while describing and narrating Him.
2MCN: The Vedas speak and expound on the Lord, but they do not know His limits.
The vedas speak of and interpret the Lord but know not His limit.
A16W: Not by studying, but through understanding, is the Lord's Mystery revealed.
Not through studying but through understanding the Lord's secret is found.
CGDD: There are six pathways in the Shaastras, but how rare are those who merge in the True Lord through them.
Six are the creeds of the Shashtras but rare is the person who merges in the True One through them.
ARN6: The True Lord is Unknowable; through the Word of His Shabad, we are embellished.
The Name of the True and inscrutable person embellishes the man.
RNTZ: One who believes in the Name of the Infinite Lord, attains the Court of the Lord.
He who believes in the Name of the Infinite One, attains His Court.
YD38: I humbly bow to the Creator Lord; I am a minstrel singing His Praises.
I, the minstrel, make obeisance to the Creator and sing His praises.
S1HC: Nanak enshrines the Lord within his mind. He is the One, throughout the ages. ||21||
Within his mind, Nanak enshrines the Lord who is but one all the ages through.
LHLT: Those who charm scorpions and handle snakes
If one be a charmer of scorpions and goes to handle serpents,
R3PP: Only brand themselves with their own hands.
with his own hands he applies a brand to his ownself then.
96WU: By the pre-ordained Order of our Lord and Master, they are beaten badly, and struck down.
It is the Master's order from the very beginning that he suffers and exceedingly great buffet.
P96Y: If the self-willed manmukhs fight with the Gurmukh, they are condemned by the Lord, the True Judge.
An apostate who contends with a pious person gets abrogated. This is the True Justice.
5CSA: He Himself is the Lord and Master of both worlds. He beholds all and makes the exact determination.
He Himself is the Lord of both the ends, beholds and discriminates.
1A0V: O Nanak, know this well: everything is in accordance with His Will. ||1||
Nanak know it like this that everything is according to His will.
ASLE: O Nanak, if someone judges himself, only then is he known as a real judge.
Nanak if man assays his own-self, then alone deem him an assayer.
FALR: If someone understands both the disease and the medicine, only then is he a wise physician.
If one understands both the disease and the medicine, then consider him a shrewd physician.
HZEY: Do not involve yourself in idle business on the way; remember that you are only a guest here.
The mortal ought not to transact idle business in the way, but should deem himself to be a guest.
XMQ0: Speak with those who know the Primal Lord, and renounce your evil ways.
He should converse with the knowers of the Primal Lord and ought to abrogate the harmful sins.
AS3J: That virtuous person who does not walk in the way of greed, and who abides in Truth, is accepted and famous.
The virtuous person, who walks not the way of avarice and abides in truth, becomes acceptable.
6DHW: If an arrow is shot at the sky, how can it reach there?
If an arrow be aimed at the sky, how can the arrow reach there?
DEUM: The sky above is unreachable-know this well, O archer! ||2||
The sky above is inaccessible Know that the arrow will recoil on the archer.
PYP9: The soul-bride loves her Husband Lord; she is embellished with His Love.
The bride loves her Spouse and with His affection she is embellished.
54M1: She worships Him day and night; she cannot be restrained from doing so.
She perform His devotional service day and night and is not held back by restraining.
DD67: In the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, she has made her home; she is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.
In Lord's palace, she has her abode and with his Name she is bedecked.
ZZGW: She is humble, and she offers her true and sincere prayer.
She the meek one makes the hearty supplication.
UU0J: She is beautiful in the Company of her Lord and Master; she walks in the Way of His Will.
She looks beauteous near her Husband and walks, according to His order.
3RMD: With her dear friends, she offers her heart-felt prayers to her Beloved.
With her dear bosom and friends she says prayers before her Lord.
6TV1: Cursed is that home, and shameful is that life, which is without the Name of the Lord.
Accursed is the abode and reproachable the life of those who are without the Lord's Name.
41Q7: But she who is adorned with the Word of His Shabad, drinks in the Amrit of His Nectar. ||22||
She is ornamented with her Lord's Name and quaffs Nectar.
90LM: The desert is not satisfied by rain, and the fire is not quenched by desire.
The desert is not satiated with rain and the hunger of fire is not quenched.
W43M: The king is not satisfied with his kingdom, and the oceans are full, but still they thirst for more.
The King is satiated not with his dominion and who has ever filled the oceans?
X4XQ: O Nanak, how many times must I seek and ask for the True Name? ||1||
How many inquiries and interrogations should Nanak make regarding the True Name? His hunger for it never appeases.
3ZN3: Life is useless, as long as one does not know the Lord God.
Until the mortal knows the Pervading God his human birth is unprofitable.
JDA6: Only a few cross over the world-ocean, by Guru's Grace.
That world-ocean few cross over by the Guru's grace.
3VM6: The Lord is the All-powerful Cause of causes, says Nanak after deep deliberation.
Potent to do all the works is the Lord. After deep deliberation Nanak says this.
TF43: The creation is subject to the Creator, who sustains it by His Almighty Power. ||2||
The creation is in the control of the Creator who by His might is sustaining it.
ZBGR: In the Court of the Lord and Master, His minstrels dwell.
In the Court of the Lord the minstrel abides.
8AZM: Singing the Praises of their True Lord and Master, the lotuses of their hearts have blossomed forth.
By singing the praises of the True Master His heart lotus has bloomed.
EJJ6: Obtaining their Perfect Lord and Master, their minds are transfixed with ecstasy.
By obtaining perfect understanding from the Master in his mind he is transported.
D2Y5: Their enemies have been driven out and subdued, and their friends are very pleased.
The enemies have been beaten off, so the friends are pleased.
0JTJ: Those who serve the Truthful True Guru are shown the True Path.
The right path is shown to them who serve the True Sat Guru.

1AB0: Reflecting on the True Word of the Shabad, death is overcome.
By meditating on the True Name, the fear of death is annulled.
38V1: Speaking the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, one is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.
The eulogist utters the ineffable Lord, and is adorned with His Name.
BS0Z: Nanak holds tight to the Treasure of Virtue, and meets with the Dear, Beloved Lord. ||23||
By holding fast the capital of virtue. Nanak has met the venerable Beloved Lord.
TYZ3: Born because of the karma of their past mistakes, they make more mistakes, and fall into mistakes.
Born from the sins and by committing sins man ever falls into sins.
MNUQ: By washing, their pollution is not removed, even though they may wash hundreds of times.
By washing the sins are never removed, even though hundreds of washings be had.
NGXS: O Nanak, if God forgives, they are forgiven; otherwise, they are kicked and beaten. ||1||
Nanak, if the Master forgives the mortals are forgiven, otherwise they are shoe-beaten.
6KPW: O Nanak, it is absurd to ask to be spared from pain by begging for comfort.
Absurd is the request, O Nanak to ask for weal by abandoning woe.
1TAJ: Pleasure and pain are the two garments given, to be worn in the Court of the Lord.
Pleasure and pain are the two raiments given to the mortal from the Lord's Court to be worn.
3QX2: Where you are bound to lose by speaking, there, you ought to remain silent. ||2||
Where one is bond to lose by utterance, it is good to keep mum there.
TSGS: After looking around in the four directions, I looked within my own self.
Looking around in four directions I searched my inner-self.
ZSW3: There, I saw the True, Invisible Lord Creator.
There I saw the invisible True Lord, the Creator.
V5US: I was wandering in the wilderness, but now the Guru has shown me the Way.
I strayed in the wilderness. The Guru has shown me the way.
Z421: Hail to the True, True Guru, through whom we merge in the Truth.
Hail to the True Sat Guru through whom I have remembered the True Lord.
W25W: I have found the jewel within the home of my own self; the lamp within has been lit.
The Guru has lighted the lamp and within my home I have found the emerald.
RNVA: Those who praise the True Word of the Shabad, abide in the peace of Truth.
The True Persons who praise the True Name remain in peace.
0YMR: But those who do not have the Fear of God, are overtaken by fear. They are destroyed by their own pride.
Awe overtakes them who are without the Lord's fear. They are destroyed by self-conceit.
014W: Having forgotten the Name, the world is roaming around like a wild demon. ||24||
Having forgotten the Name the world is roaming about like a demon.
HGWD: In fear we are born, and in fear we die. Fear is always present in the mind.
In fear the man is born, in fear he dies and fear ever abides within his mind.
MJC3: O Nanak, if one dies in the fear of God, his coming into the world is blessed and approved. ||1||
Nanak if man dies in the Lord's fear, fruitful becomes his advent.
Y9U4: Without the fear of God, you may live very, very long, and savor the most enjoyable pleasures.
Without God's fear the mortal lives very long and enjoys pleasure of pleasures.
G7SM: O Nanak, if you die without the fear of God, you will arise and depart with a blackened face. ||2||
Nanak, if he dies without God's fear he will get up and depart with the blackened face.
ABYC: Sardha = faith, trust. Daial = merciful. Pooriai = complete, firm.
The person on whom the Satguru shows grace (comes to have) firm trust (in Parmatma).
When the True Guru is merciful, then your desires will be fulfilled.
When the True Guru becomes merciful, desire is fulfilled then.
If the Satguru is merciful, then faith becomes complete.
ZG5S: He never complains (when any suffering or trouble comes),
When the True Guru is merciful, you will never grieve.
When the True Guru becomes merciful, man grieves not ever.
If the Satguru is merciful, then there is never any grieving.
1DUM: (because) he does not take (any suffering that comes) as suffering;
When the True Guru is merciful, you will know no pain.
When the True Guru becomes merciful, man knows no pain then.
If the Satguru is merciful, then no suffering is felt.
QJ9V: he always enjoys the bliss of union with the Prabhu.
When the True Guru is merciful, you will enjoy the Lord's Love.
When the True Guru becomes merciful then man enjoys God's love.
If the Satguru is merciful, then Hari's (rang) bliss is enjoyed.
Y9M1: (Let alone suffering and trouble,) he no longer has even the fear of Yama.
When the True Guru is merciful, then why should you fear death?
When the True Guru becomes merciful, then what fear has man of death?
If the Satguru is merciful, then what fear of Yama? The meaning is, there is no fear of Yama.
TNWK: (In this way) his body is always at peace.
When the True Guru is merciful, the body is always at peace.
When the True Guru becomes merciful then the body is ever in peace.
If the Satguru is merciful, then the body stays ever at peace.
ELY9: The one on whom the Guru becomes merciful has (as it were) received all nine treasures of the world,
When the True Guru is merciful, the nine treasures are obtained.
When the True Guru becomes merciful then the nine treasures are obtained.
If the Satguru is merciful, then the nine treasures are received.
15QX: (because) he stays joined to the true Prabhu (the Master of the treasures). ||25||
When the True Guru is merciful, you shall be absorbed in the True Lord. ||25||
When the True Guru becomes merciful then is the man absorbed in the True Lord.

If the Satguru is merciful, then one merges into Parmatma, whose form is Truth. ||25|| ☬ The king of the city of Haru, on an island in the middle of the ocean, was a follower of the Jain monks. Sri Guru Nanak Sahib ji went there. Because no rain had fallen in that country, the people, in distress, fell into his refuge, and Sri Guru ji brought rain. The king, together with his subjects, became the Guru's Sikh. Then that Jain monk came to debate. In reference to him Sri Guru ji uttered a salok. Then, hearing of the wrong practices of the Jain monks, he himself repented and fell into the Guru's refuge. The Guru made him too his Sikh and made him head of the dharamsal. Now he describes the condition of those Jain monks:
3MP6: They pluck the hair out of their heads, and drink in filthy water; they beg endlessly and eat the garbage which others have thrown away.
They have their heads plucked, drink dirty water and repeatedly beg and eat other's leavings.
H2K5: They spread manure, they suck in rotting smells, and they are afraid of clean water.
They spread out ordure with their mouths suck its ordure and dread to look at water.
DRAZ: Their hands are smeared with ashes, and the hair on their heads is plucked out-they are like sheep!
With hands smeared with ashes, they have their heads plucked like sheep.
NK79: They have renounced the lifestyle of their mothers and fathers, and their families and relatives cry out in distress.
The daily routine of their mothers and fathers they give up and their kith and kin bewail loudly.
3A70: No one offers the rice dishes at their last rites, and no one lights the lamps for them. After their death, where will they be sent?
For them none gives barley rolls and food on leaves nor performs last rites nor lights earthen lamp. After death where shall your be cast?
QLFU: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage give them no place of protection, and no Brahmin will eat their food.
The sixty-eight places of pilgrimage grant them no refuge, and Pandits eat not their food.
4R5P: They remain polluted forever, day and night; they do not apply the ceremonial tilak mark to their foreheads.
They ever remain filthy day and night and bear not sacrificial marks on their brow.
J019: They sit together in silence, as if in mourning; they do not go to the Lord's Court.
They ever sit in groups as if in mourning and go not into the True Court.
HU2Q: With their begging bowls hanging from their waists, and their fly-brushes in their hands, they walk along in single file.
With begging bowls slung round their loins and a clew in their hands they walk in single file.
98MX: They are not Yogis, and they are not Jangams, followers of Shiva. They are not Qazis or Mullahs.
They are neither disciples of Gorakh nor adorers of Shiva nor Muslim judges and Muslim preachers.

3JPK: Ruined by the Merciful Lord, they wander around in disgrace, and their entire troop is contaminated.
Ruined by God, they walk about disgraced and their entire multitude goes contaminated.
GJ6D: The Lord alone kills and restores to life; no one else can protect anyone from Him.
The beings that Lord alone kills and restores to life. None else can protect them.
LCW6: They go without giving alms or any cleansing baths; their shaven heads become covered with dust.
They go without giving alms and performing ablutions. The dust alights on their plucked heads.
6YRK: The jewel emerged from the water, when the mountain of gold was used to churn it.
From within water came out the jewel, when the mountain of gold was made the churning staff.
2UJK: The gods established the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where the festivals are celebrated and hymns are chanted.
The gods appointed the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage, where festivals are celebrated and hymns are recited.
MTBW: After bathing, the Muslims recite their prayers, and after bathing, the Hindus perform their worship services. The wise always take cleansing baths.
After ablution the Muslims say prayers after wash the Hindus perform worship and the wise ever bathe.
GFZM: At the time of death, and at the time of birth, they are purified, when water is poured on their heads.
The dead and the living are purified when water is poured on their heads.
FTCQ: O Nanak, the shaven-headed ones are devils. They are not pleased to hear these words.
Nanak, the head-plucked are devils. This word of advice pleases them not.
0LRM: When it rains, there is happiness. Water is the key to all life.
When it rains, there is happiness. The key to the life of beings is contained in water.
Z39L: When it rains, the corn grows, and the sugar cane, and the cotton, which provides clothing for all.
When it rains there is corn sugar cane and cotton which affords covering to all.
2952: When it rains, the cows always have grass to graze upon, and housewives can churn the milk into butter.
When it rains the cows ever graze grass and the women churn the curd of their milk.
PGED: With that ghee, sacred feasts and worship services are performed; all these efforts are blessed.
By putting that clarified butter havan, sacred feasts and worships are ever performed and other ceremonies are adorned.
U16C: The Guru is the ocean, and all His Teachings are the river. Bathing within it, glorious greatness is obtained.
The Guru is the ocean and all his teachings are the river by bathing where-in greatness is obtained.
JJ18: O Nanak, if the shaven-headed ones do not bathe, then seven handfuls of ashes are upon their heads. ||1||
Nanak, if the plucked-heads bathe not, then seven handfuls of ashes be on their heads.
7WBD: What can the cold do to the fire? How can the night affect the sun?
What can cold do to fire and how can night affect the sun?
CWE0: What can the darkness do to the moon? What can social status do to air and water?
What effect can darkness have on the moon? What effect has caste on air and water?
BLFH: What are personal possessions to the earth, from which all things are produced?
What should the earth do with chattels, where-in all the things are produced?
BKVN: O Nanak, he alone is known as honorable, whose honor the Lord preserves. ||2||
Nanak then alone the mortal is deemed honourable when that lord preserves his honour.
U3D1: It is of You, O my True and Wondrous Lord, that I sing forever.
Yours, O my wonderous True Lord! I have ever sung the praises.
UT7B: Yours is the True Court. All others are subject to coming and going.
You alone have the eternal court. All others are subject to coming and going.
295Y: Those who ask for the gift of the True Name are like You.
They, who ask for the gift of the True Name, are like You.
M959: Your Command is True; we are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad.
True is Yours command. With Yours Name the Man is bedecked.
KA1Z: Through faith and trust, we receive spiritual wisdom and meditation from You.
Believing in You, O Lord! man receives from You Divine knowledge and Your meditation.
T7SY: By Your Grace, the banner of honor is obtained. It cannot be taken away or lost.
By Yours grace, man obtains the mark of honour which cannot be effaced by effacing.
3KSD: You are the True Giver; You give continually. Your Gifts continue to increase.
You the True Bestower ever givest. Yours gifts become more and more.
YL3W: Nanak begs for that gift which is pleasing to You. ||26||
Nanak asks for the gift which is pleasing to You, O Lord!
1JCL: Those who have accepted the Guru's Teachings, and who have found the path, remain absorbed in the Praises of the True Lord.
They, whom the instruction (of Guru Nanak) has taught and put on the right path remain absorbed in the praises of the True Lord.
W841: What teachings can be imparted to those who have the Divine Guru Nanak as their Guru? ||1||
What instruction can be imparted to them, who have God-incarnate Nanak as their Guru?
K7KP: We understand the Lord only when He Himself inspires us to understand Him.
He, whom He Himself causes to understand understands Him.
PEFS: He alone knows everything, to whom the Lord Himself gives knowledge.
Whom the Lord Himself gives knowledge, he comes to know every thing.
UC3X: One may talk and preach and give sermons but still yearn after Maya.
The preacher regularly preaches and sermons but longs for wealth.
BCAP: The Lord, by the Hukam of His Command, has created the entire creation.
The Commander has created the entire creation.
38GU: He Himself knows the inner nature of all.
He Himself understands the mental out-look of all.
145X: O Nanak, He Himself uttered the Word.
Nanak, the Lord Himself has uttered forth the Word.
M6DX: Doubt departs from one who receives this gift. ||2||
Doubt departs from Him who receives the gift.
6603: I was a minstrel, out of work, when the Lord took me into His service.
Me, the bard out of work, the Lord has applied to His service.
UYR8: To sing His Praises day and night, He gave me His Order, right from the start.
In the very beginning He gave me the order to sing His praises night and day.
W8PC: My Lord and Master has summoned me, His minstrel, to the True Mansion of His Presence.
The Master summoned the minstrel to His True Court.
1Q5W: He has dressed me in the robes of His True Praise and Glory.
He clothed me with the robe of His true Honour and eulogy.
1KMA: The Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name has become my food.
Since then the True Name has become my ambrosial food.
57GV: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings, who eat this food and are satisfied, find peace.
They, who under the Guru's instruction, eat this food to their satisfaction, obtain peace.
6FRB: His minstrel spreads His Glory, singing and vibrating the Word of His Shabad.
By singing the Guru's hymns, I the minstrel spread the Lord's glory.
AMPW: O Nanak, praising the True Lord, I have obtained His Perfection. ||27||Sudh||
Nanak, by praising the True Name I have obtained the perfect Lord.
